sn35.67:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, dukkhaṃ vā assa dukkhapaññatti vāti? yattha kho samiddhi atthi cakkhu, atthi rūpā, atthi cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, atthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha dukkhaṃ vā dukkhapaññatti vā. …pe…
sn35.67:1.3: atthi jivhā, atthi rasā …pe… atthi mano, atthi dhammā, atthi manoviññāṇaṃ, atthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha dukkhaṃ vā dukkhapaññatti vā. yattha ca kho samiddhi natthi cakkhu, natthi rūpā, natthi cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, natthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, natthi tattha dukkhaṃ vā dukkhapaññatti vā. …pe… natthi jivhā, natthi rasā, …pe… natthi mano, natthi dhammā, natthi manoviññāṇaṃ, natthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, natthi tattha dukkhaṃ vā dukkhapaññatti vāti.
